statement: Pattern inference uses three evidence levels — E (explicit workbook structure/observed formula fact, still not proof of business intent), S (structural suggestion), and W (weak semantic guess) — always paired with evidence disclosure and address; 'bound' means resolving to an existing cell/range/object, whereas any new formula, name, scenario, or chart is an explicit workbook edit.
why: Keeps pattern confidence transparent and distinguishes view bindings from model creation.

statement: P-01 Sheet as database (Sales: repeated order rows beneath one header; filtering, IDs, quantities, amounts). Evidence/limit: E for `Orders` Table and its declared range; S for rectangular ordinary ranges with consistent column types; neither proves key uniqueness or absence of subtotals. Confirm/correct: Accept row/header range; mark `Order ID` as a display key; show duplicate counts; exclude totals; do not convert to a Table without an explicit model edit. Views — Classic: Full Orders table; headers, filters, pinned columns; Inspector: Selected row/value provenance; type/duplicate/error summaries with exact scope; Notebook: Bound table with visible total/filtered count and row window; underlying data remains accessible; Model map: One Orders node with column/row-count ports; expand chosen fields; App: Approved search/filter/table panel; edit only allowed input columns.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-02 Inputs and assumptions (Budget: twelve labelled assumptions with Base/Stretch columns; Loan: principal, rate and term). Evidence/limit: E for validation and named ranges; S for constants feeding formulas; W from colour, border or words such as `Input`. Confirm/correct: Confirm editable cells, labels, units and scenario columns; exclude constants that are historical observations; show protection/validation independently. Views — Classic: Existing assumption cells and validation; Inspector: Input -> dependents; constants/protected state; Notebook: Labelled bound controls beside explanation; Model map: Input node or ports, exact cells on focus; App: Main input form with units, validation and source details.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-03 Calculation blocks (Monthly revenue and cost rows repeat across Jan-Dec). Evidence/limit: E for repeated relative formula structure; S for borders, labels and adjacency; a shared pattern is not proof of a shared business role. Confirm/correct: Show exact member ranges and exceptions; rename/split/merge visual grouping; retain hard-coded overrides as explicit exceptions. Views — Classic: Original rows/columns; exceptional formula visible; Inspector: One formula family plus exception list; Notebook: Formula block with result table and source range; Model map: Calculation block with grouped edges and member count; App: Selected outputs; advanced detail can reveal block.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-04 Time series across columns (Budget dates progress left to right; repeated monthly calculations). Evidence/limit: E for values and references; S for date cadence and repeated formulas; text `Jan` alone does not prove year, cadence or chronology. Confirm/correct: Confirm period row, order, date system context and units; distinguish actual dates from captions; reverse or skip periods only in presentation with a notice. Views — Classic: Original twelve columns, freeze labels; Inspector: Period-relative dependencies and exceptions; Notebook: Compact time table/chart, horizontal pipeline if chosen; Model map: Period-labelled block; expand a chosen period, do not duplicate an unbounded timeline; App: Bound chart and period selector, if selection already has a workbook meaning.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-05 Scenarios and sensitivity (Budget's Base/Stretch columns; Loan's alternative assumptions). Evidence/limit: E for existing What-If data tables or stored scenario structures; S for parallel columns; W that differing inputs mean scenarios. Confirm/correct: Name input/output sets; distinguish viewing an existing scenario from writing selected input cells; review new scenario tables as workbook edits. Views — Classic: Existing scenario cells/data table; Inspector: Compared inputs/results with calculation state; Notebook: Side-by-side bound scenario results; Model map: Parallel input sets feeding the same calculation block; App: Explicit `Try`/`Apply` behavior with baseline and changed-input list.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-06 Reference tables and lookups (Sales product/customer mappings, XLOOKUP keys and return columns). Evidence/limit: E for lookup arguments/table structure; S for key-like columns; duplicate keys and approximate matches may be intentional. Confirm/correct: Confirm key and descriptive fields; reveal duplicate/missing keys and actual match mode; never silently deduplicate or sort. Views — Classic: Lookup table/filter and source formulas; Inspector: Match mode, actual matched rows, duplicate/missing-key warnings; Notebook: Lookup explanation and bounded reference table; Model map: Reference-table node, actual lookup dependency; App: Validated chooser with key/label and missing-key errors.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-07 Pipelines across sheets (Inputs -> Monthly -> Summary; Orders -> Report). Evidence/limit: E for resolved dependencies; S for dominant direction; dynamic references and external links can make the relation incomplete. Confirm/correct: Approve stages and grouping; label cross-links; disclose unresolved or runtime-only dependencies; allow one cell to appear in more than one presentation. Views — Classic: Sheet tabs, formula references; Inspector: Cross-sheet path, omitted branch count and dynamic edges; Notebook: Reading sequence can differ from calculation order; Model map: Nested sheet/stage groups with actual edges; App: Published process steps only; formulas still evaluate by workbook rules.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-08 Running balances (Loan balance carries from preceding row and subtracts principal). Evidence/limit: E for previous-row recurrence; S for a balance interpretation or its units. Confirm/correct: Confirm opening/closing terms and period axis; expose the first-row seed; do not treat a row recurrence as an iterative circular calculation. Views — Classic: 360-row Loan schedule; Inspector: Seed, previous-row relation, final balance and exceptions; Notebook: Schedule excerpt labelled `rows 1-12 of 360`; full table action; Model map: One recurrence block with initial state and period axis; App: Summary/graph plus expandable full schedule.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-09 Deliberate circular calculation (Stock's circular estimate, iteration enabled, convergence readout). Evidence/limit: E for a resolved cycle and workbook iteration settings; W for intent/convergence without evidence; unknown dependencies remain unknown. Confirm/correct: Show participating cells and settings; ask whether intended; approval annotates intent only; enabling iteration is a separate workbook-setting edit. Views — Classic: Actual circular formulas and workbook settings; Inspector: Cycle members, iteration count/residual if supplied, convergence/limit state; Notebook: Explanation plus latest actual result; no fake run button; Model map: Explicit iteration enclosure, separate from delay notation; App: Show current result and convergence warning; do not hide failure.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-10 Simulation / repeated trials (A trial table, random functions, or an existing macro/data-table sweep). Evidence/limit: E for RAND/RANDBETWEEN and data-table/macro presence; S that repeated rows are independent trials; distributions and independence are not inferred facts. Confirm/correct: Confirm trial axis, outputs and refresh trigger; show random/volatile markers; no view-side random generator, reseeding, or invented execution clock. Views — Classic: Existing trial grid/data table; Inspector: Volatility, trigger and observed run provenance; Notebook: Bound distribution chart with sample/trial counts; Model map: Trial/sweep block only when workbook mechanism is known; App: Approved controls and real trigger, visible result freshness.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-11 Control panels (Loan labelled controls; Stock reorder slider; buttons beside outputs). Evidence/limit: E for controls and linked cells; S for inferred input labels; a control can invoke a macro rather than write a value. Confirm/correct: Inspect each binding/action; approve grouping and tab order; preserve the control's actual min/max/step and linked-cell meaning. Views — Classic: Original form controls and bindings; Inspector: Control -> linked cell/macro effects; Notebook: Embedded original control or faithful alternative; Model map: Parameter port with bound control; App: Primary form/button layout; permission and disabled reason visible.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-12 Pivot summaries (Sales PivotTable, dimensions, totals and filters). Evidence/limit: E for PivotTable and cache/refresh information available in workbook; source freshness may be unknown. Confirm/correct: Choose shown dimensions; disclose refresh time/status when known; filter or refresh through the real pivot action, not a new view-only aggregate. Views — Classic: Native pivot layout and field/filter operations; Inspector: Cache/source lineage and refresh state; Notebook: Bound pivot with exact filters and totals; Model map: Pivot node between source and report; App: Approved slicers/filter controls and existing pivot results.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-13 Live data (RTD/external feed values change while the workbook is open). Evidence/limit: E for supported provider and observed updates; unavailable provider or stored result does not imply live connection. Confirm/correct: Confirm displayed source/units; show connected/stale/paused/unavailable; configure history retention as presentation; keep pause-observation distinct from stopping the feed. Views — Classic: Live cells with freshness/status cue; Inspector: Timestamped values, source state and labelled retained history; Notebook: Live result/chart, still respecting calculation mode; Model map: External-source node and actual observed updates; App: Source state next to results; no claim of currentness when stale.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-14 Macro-driven models (Inherited buttons/module and values changed by a macro). Evidence/limit: E for macro/assigned-action presence; W for effects inferred from code text; runtime observations may be partial. Confirm/correct: Show permission and platform state; record actual changed regions after a run; do not label an unexecuted macro's effects as known. Views — Classic: Workbook and real macro controls; Inspector: Permission, run boundaries and observed changes; Notebook: Bound result with last-run status; explicit macro action; Model map: Macro as action/observed-effects node, never invented dependency truth; App: Authorized macro button; plain refusal and desktop route if unavailable.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-15 Reports and dashboards (Summary KPIs, captions, charts and print areas). Evidence/limit: E for chart objects/print areas; S for report intent; merged cells and bold numbers alone are weak. Confirm/correct: Confirm reading order and source bindings; pin chart objects and outputs; keep explanatory prose separate from workbook values. Views — Classic: Original report and chart objects; Inspector: KPI -> source/formatting/data lineage; Notebook: Main reading/publishing surface; Model map: Output group, select a KPI to trace; App: Main presentation surface, authored reading order.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-16 Stocks and flows (Stock opening stock + arrivals - shipments = closing stock). Evidence/limit: E for an arithmetic relationship; S for quantity accumulation; W that every additive relationship is a physical flow. Confirm/correct: Confirm units and stock/flow roles; expose sign conventions and bounds; the diagram follows the actual formula and can be corrected independently. Views — Classic: Actual balance formulas; Inspector: Inflow/outflow/stock relationships and units; Notebook: Short explanation, bound table/chart; Model map: Main systems surface; flow role is confirmed annotation; App: Stock outputs and input controls relevant to operator.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-17 Feedback and delays (Stock reorder decisions affect later arrivals; arrows return to inventory). Evidence/limit: E for dependencies; S for feedback at a grouped level; a circular reference is not itself a time delay. Confirm/correct: Confirm lag and period axis from explicit formulas/rows; label `3 days` only with that evidence; use `iteration` for convergence loops. Views — Classic: Rows or columns implementing actual lag; Inspector: Separate dependency cycle from period lag; Notebook: Explicit lag explanation and result sequence; Model map: Labelled delayed dependency or iteration enclosure, according to evidence; App: Timing/lag explanation near outputs when it affects interpretation.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-18 Reconciliation and control totals (Inputs equal outputs; check is zero; Grand Total comparisons). Evidence/limit: E for subtraction/equality expressions; S for their role as checks; tolerance and materiality cannot be invented. Confirm/correct: Confirm check cells and what zero/TRUE means; surface existing tolerance; adding new checks or IFERROR is a separate model change. Views — Classic: Check cells and original tolerance formulas; Inspector: Failed checks grouped by affected output; no invented repairs; Notebook: Visible check summary with exact predicate; Model map: Check attached to relevant block; App: Compact checks; failure stays visible and affects readiness label.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-19 Exceptions and overrides (One hard-coded value interrupts a formula run; errors or unusual formats). Evidence/limit: E for difference from neighbouring formula structure; W that the exception is a mistake. Confirm/correct: Keep `exception` distinct from `error`; mark accepted override with an annotation; propose repair only with original/new formula and downstream preview. Views — Classic: Exact override/error cell; Inspector: Explain deviation, original neighbours and dependents; Notebook: Exception footnote linked to cell; Model map: Badge on containing block; expand precise member; App: Relevant warning, original error text and a source link.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-20 Repeated-sheet families (Similar regional/monthly sheets feed a consolidation sheet). Evidence/limit: E for matching structure/reference patterns; S for family membership; hidden sheets and local names may differ materially. Confirm/correct: Approve group, order and representative sheet; list all deviations and all members, including hidden status; never fold exceptions out of the summary. Views — Classic: All original sheets and hidden status; Inspector: Family differences and consolidation lineage; Notebook: Representative template plus all-member list; Model map: Family group with member/exception counts; App: Approved region/period chooser backed by existing workbook selection.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-21 External-file consolidation (Inherited references missing supplier or rates files). Evidence/limit: E for external-link records and resolved formulas; last stored value is not current external evidence. Confirm/correct: Map/repair a link through a workbook edit; keep `missing file`, `update not requested` and `cached result` distinct; allow read-only investigation. Views — Classic: External-link formula and stored value; Inspector: File status, known/unknown link targets and last update; Notebook: Cached-result notice and source citation; Model map: External boundary node with unresolved-edge marker; App: Visible stale/missing-source state; no optimistic `Ready`.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-22 Spill / array result (Sales FILTER result occupies changing rows; outline has one anchor). Evidence/limit: E for array/spill metadata and occupied cells; obstruction or unavailable calculation may leave shape unknown. Confirm/correct: Confirm presentation columns/labels; preserve anchor ownership; editing a spill child refuses with a jump to the anchor or obstruction. Views — Classic: Anchor/spill boundary/obstruction; Inspector: Shape, anchor, dependent ranges and error origin; Notebook: Reactive data-frame display with anchor label; Model map: Array port with dimensions or `shape unavailable`; App: Bound result table; edit requests lead to permitted inputs.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: P-23 Irregular forms and sparse layouts (Inherited contains forms, blank spacing, merged labels and separate small islands). Evidence/limit: E for cell/object geometry; S for label-to-value pairing; proximity alone is weak. Confirm/correct: Correct groups and reading order; preserve a Classic fallback; show `Unclassified content` rather than assigning a false model type. Views — Classic: Complete faithful escape hatch; Inspector: Unclassified islands, objects and formula/error inventory; Notebook: User-selected excerpts with address captions; Model map: Sheet/block overview, no forced semantic labels; App: Decline automatic publication; show `Choose inputs and outputs first`.
why: Defines recognition evidence, correction rules, and coherent five-view presentation for a recurring spreadsheet pattern.

statement: The five cast fixtures use English formula syntax (comma separators, '.' decimals), actual date values (not ambiguous strings), ZAR display formatting, and full internal calculation precision (no precision-as-displayed; round only visible text), with each storyboard starting from its stated baseline independently and formulas retaining meaning across regional locale changes.
why: Provides exact, unambiguous arithmetic baselines for prototyping and review.

statement: Budget fixture (Inputs, Monthly, Summary): Inputs!A1:C13 holds 12 Base/Stretch assumptions as an ordinary range (colours never auto-convert to an Excel Table; Stretch is not a secretly active model; unused cash/tax/debtor rows never claim operating-profit impact), Monthly B1:M11 computes 12 months (base profit 18,000/mo, Summary!B7 216,000/yr; B3=125 gives 276,000/yr with 24 changed values in Monthly!B8:M11; B3=125 & B4=72 gives 252,000/yr with 36 changed values), plus optional Budget.* names, Summary!A20 TRANSPOSE blocked by A21 note, and Summary!D14 DNA.DISCOUNT.
why: Authoritative numeric and formula specification for Budget storyboards S03-S05 and S14-S16.

statement: Sales fixture (Orders, Report, Pivot): Orders!A1:G25001 is a real 25,000-row Excel Table where West has exactly 125 Paid orders (124,250) and 1 Pending order (SO10482, data row 10482 / sheet row 10483, 4,200); Report!B5 starts at 128,450 (missing Status criterion) and repairs to 124,250, alongside XLOOKUP (B7), FILTER (A12), and an independently refresh-tracked PivotTable, with generated filler rows explicitly disclosed as synthetic.

(120/0.1->108, 120/0.2->96, 120/1.2->#NUM!) and caller-dependent DNA.CALLERADDRESS() refused in standalone mode; the design does not require running native XLL binaries in a browser, but requires explicit disclosure of provider/runtime requirements, equivalent implementations, and the user's chosen host.

statement: Independent arithmetic checks on Budget, Loan, Stock, and Sales confirm internal numerical consistency of the design examples only; they do not establish Excel runtime parity, native add-in loading, accessibility conformance, opening speed, or custom-XML round-trip preservation, which remain acceptance criteria in Appendices A-C.
why: Maintains strict honesty about what a design specification has and has not verified.
